edits.before: Q both passes through the contacts — the boomerang bills twice; stand where the return doubles.
edits.after: His fourth-shot crit and reload burst out-trade your early autos — greedy step-ups get punished hard.

edits.before: W-bounce the duo trades: the ricochet taxes his support for standing in formation.
edits.after: His fourth-shot crit keeps level 2 in his favor — you play careful, not forcing the fight.

edits.before: Spell shield games begin: every ability he aims is now a mana refund audition.
edits.after: His W root threatens a combo you can't answer yet — hold Spell Shield, not poke.

edits.before: Shove the metronome: your W clears set the lane's tempo — he farms under tower or fights your timing.
edits.after: His front-loaded damage still out-duels you in short trades through 4-5, so farm rather than force it.

edits.before: Late Sivir conducts: speed the engage, shield the answer, and ricochet the teamfight through its own front line.
edits.after: With two items your On the Hunt speed and Ricochet cleave outscale his reload-locked DPS, flipping the lane.

edits.before: - Jhin Deadly Flourish (Root): matchup-defining — The cross-map root chains off any damage you took — never linger after a trade. Check it before every step-up. - E Spell Shield is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Jhin Deadly Flourish (Root, 12s CD): the cross-map root chains off any damage you took — never linger after a trade. - E Spell Shield (24-18s CD) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The 120/105/90s R answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Bank the E for his W (12s CD) — a blocked Deadly Flourish denies the whole root-into-burst combo outright.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Chasing a kill off your tempo hands him free farm, reload time, and lotus traps set for the fight you forced.
